name: 365 day BiL eligibility
description: SLD POSTs a draft 2-year apprenticeship for Riley Brooks (DOB 2012-01-01, start 2030-04-01), and the employer approves it. PUTs a break in learning starting on day 182 (pause 2030-09-29), resuming 2032-01-01. The learner accrues 183 more actual days post-break, reaching 365 total on withdrawal date 2032-07-01. The 365-day incentive milestone is reached — both incentive payments should be generated. Then moves the withdrawal back one day to 2032-06-30 (364 total days) — both incentives should be removed. Finally moves the return date forward one day to 2031-12-31, restoring 365 total days — both incentives should be regenerated. Then moves the withdrawal back one day to 2032-06-29 (364 total days) — both incentives should be removed again. Finally lengthens the break by one day (pause 2030-09-30), restoring 365 total days — both incentives should be regenerated.

SLD Moves Return Date Forward One Day (2031-12-31) — 182 pre-break + 183 post-break = 365 days total
SLD Moves Withdrawal Back to Day 364 (2032-06-29) — 182 pre-break + 182 post-break = 364 days total
SLD Lengthens Break by One Day (pause 2030-09-30) — 183 pre-break + 182 post-break = 365 days total
